compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is from the "Martian Notifier" app, specifically under the "Setup" tab. The main contents and functions available on this screen include:

1. **Choose Language**: Option to select the preferred language.
2. **Enable LED**: Checkbox to enable or disable the LED notification.
3. **Enable Leash**: Checkbox to enable or disable the leash feature.
4. **Choose Date Format**: Option to select the preferred date format.
5. **Choose Time Format**: Option to select the preferred time format.
6. **Choose Scroll Speed**: Option to set the scroll speed, currently set to 1.
7. **Choose Alert Scroll Delay**: Option to set the alert scroll delay, currently set to 5 seconds.
8. **Character Limit**: Checkbox to enable or disable character limit.

At the bottom, there is a button labeled "Confirm Changes" to save any modifications made on this screen.
